messages:
Alex K: Quick check — aiming to cut v0.23.4 tomorrow 17:00 PT. Can owners confirm version bump, changelog entry, and security sign-off? :rocket:

Priya S: I bumped package.json (runtime) in my branch, PR at https://git.redwood/infra/runtime/pull/4923. Need one more review + CI green.

Marco L: Docs: I'll draft the changelog entry now. Note: batching behavior tweak is a breaking change for some customers, will call it out. Draft link in a sec.

Tina R: QA: smoke on ci/staging is passing for main scenarios. I'll run the canary suite at 13:00 PT and post results here. If anything fails I'll open an issue. :eyes:

Chris M: Security: Snyk baseline OK but dependency `libx` flagged medium — opened SEC-321 with remediation steps. No blocker for cutoff if patch backport goes in.

release-bot: Heads up — branch freeze in 4h. Please have merges and changelog in before freeze window.

Priya S: Ping for reviews — @Marco L @Tina R can you take a pass on #4923? small tweak in package-lock, nothing fancy.

Marco L: LGTM, left one wording suggestion in the changelog. Approving after fix.

Tina R: Approved from QA POV. Will rerun smoke after PR merge and post canary results.

Chris M: Security sign-off: approved for this release once SEC-321 has the short-term patch (we'll track the full upgrade post-release).

Priya S: Fixed Marco's wording, updated PR. CI queued.

qa-bot: Canary run started (canary/2026-03-17-13:02). Tests: 114/114 passing so far. No regressions detected.

Alex K: Status roundup: [x] version bump (runtime) [x] changelog draft (Marco) [x] QA smoke/canary [x] security sign-off [ ] final docs link into release notes — Marco to paste final before 15:30 PT. If that lands, I'll trigger cut tomorrow at 17:00 PT.

Marco L: Pasted changelog snippet: ```
### v0.23.4 - 2026-03-18
- Fix: reduce KV cache thrash on short-lived sessions
- Change: batching window tightened (BREAKING CHANGE for custom batching plugins) — see migration notes
- Perf: kernel selection tweaks for Llama-family models
```

Alex K: Perfect — thanks all. I'll put a final reminder in the morning and schedule the cutoff once final docs link is in. :white_check_mark:
